items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Should we get his hat on, Wilson?

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you, we was on a job one time, and so one of the boys went out for the end of the morning going to work. And while he's on his way to work, he met two ladies, and the two ladies was fighting, one big, stark lady and a little small lady. Well, by that time, the little lady gets loose from the big lady, and she runs out and gets her brick, as they call it, and hit the big lady in the head and cut her head and started to bleed. By that time, the policeman come by. And so the only man that could pick…
Oh, that's great. That's funny. You want to wash your hands, sir? Want your hat? Should we get his hat on, Wilson? I don't want to have.
